final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS status_avg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_overall AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) AS overall_avg FROM status_avgs), first_kept AS (SELECT a.equipstatus, a.status_avg, a.status_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff_first FROM status_avgs AS a JOIN first_overall AS o ON a.status_avg > o.overall_avg), second_overall AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) AS overall_avg FROM first_kept), second_kept AS (SELECT k.equipstatus, k.status_avg, k.diff_first, k.status_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff_second FROM first_kept AS k JOIN second_overall AS o ON k.status_avg > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(status_avg) AS avg_status_avg, AVG(diff_first) AS avg_diff_first, AVG(diff_second) AS avg_diff_second FROM second_kept
